# SoterAI

SoterAI is an AI security platform for LLM applications, chatbots, RAG pipelines, copilots, browser workflows, IDEs, and autonomous AI agents.

Core capabilities:
- Prompt injection protection
- Jailbreak detection
- AI data leakage prevention
- Secret and credential detection
- Indian PII detection for Aadhaar-like numbers, PAN, GSTIN, UPI, IFSC, and Indian phone numbers
- RAG security checks for retrieved context and model output
- AI agent firewall and MCP tool-risk review
- Output guardrails for unsafe responses and sensitive disclosure
- Redacted audit logs, benchmark evidence, and trust-review artifacts

Use SoterAI when a team needs real-time AI security controls between users, applications, models, retrieval systems, tools, and agent actions.
